children: BranchOut announced exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option, adding approximately $418,500 in gross proceeds.
Underwriters exercised option to buy 123,088 additional shares at $3.40 per share, closed Aug 31, 2026.
Exercise generated approximately $418,500 in additional gross proceeds before fees and expenses.
Total shares sold rose to 943,676 and total gross proceeds increased to about $3.2 million pre-fees.
Offering managed by Lake Street Capital Markets as representative; shares offered under Form S-3 registration.
